text:
Jamie: quick q — can we surface a lightweight onboarding flow for enterprise admins that lets them grant fine-grained routes/quotas during tenant setup?
Maria: yes, customers keep asking for faster admin onboarding. current console forces a multi-step role+scope manual edit which is painful.
Kevin: agree. +1 to a guided 'entitlement wizard' but need to be careful about telemetry implications (we'll get a lot of tiny changes).
Olivia: what are the minimal fields we actually need at signup? route scope, token TTL, quota bucket?
Jamie: thinking minimal: role template (viewer/editor/admin), per-route boolean toggles, quota preset (S/M/L/custom), and an opt-in for telemetry sampling.
Maria: for enterprise controls we also need an "audit-only" preview and a way to attach policy reasons (free text) so CSMs can review.
Kevin: implementation constraint: our backend API currently takes full role objects, not partial diffs. two options: (1) create a staged role object then PATCH on confirm, or (2) extend the API to accept a concise entitlement payload (preferred long-term).
Devex: (cc @Jamie @Kevin) if you go with concise payload we'll need SDK updates and a migration doc for partners. can we keep server-side validation strict to avoid holes?
sre-bot: deploy-notify: feature-flag ent-wizard staged to canary namespace (eng-platform) at 2024-10-12T16:02Z :rocket:
Jamie: sweet. thoughts on UX for quotas? default presets are easiest but we need to show estimated cost delta per preset.
Olivia: +cost delta. Console should show a token-per-day estimate and an ops note: "applies per-route". Also show breach-action options (block/soft-throttle/notify).
Maria: we also need audit telemetry: tag who created the entitlement, which template used, and include a compact diff in the tenant audit log. otherwise support can't tell what changed.
Kevin: backend plan: add /entitlements/compact POST that returns a staged id and cost-estimate. then the console hits /entitlements/commit with staged id to materialize role objects. keeps current role APIs untouched.
Jamie: love that — minimizes migration risk. can we get a sample payload?
Kevin: sample:
```
POST /entitlements/compact
{
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "items": [
    {"route": "text.generate", "allow": true, "quota": "S"},
    {"route": "embeddings.create", "allow": false}
  ],
  "template": "editor-lite"
}
```
Response includes staged_id and cost_estimate_tokens/day.
Devex: we should include an optional "accept_regression_risk" flag for canarying model routing changes (some entitlements may change which model variant is used).
Olivia: small UX ask: when a preset changes cost estimate by >20% show a red caution chip with a hover explaining the delta and a link to the batching/quantization docs.
Maria: rollout plan: feature-flag behind ent-wizard, start with internal tenants + 3 pilot customers, then enable org-admins opt-in from settings. telemetry sampling at 10% for first 2 weeks.
Kevin: agree. telemetry: we must record staged->commit latency and any validation errors. add a metric `entitlements.commit.failure_rate` and a histogram for validation error types.
Jamie: ops question — who owns the UI copy for "quota preset" vs "custom quota"? wording matters to reduce support tickets.
Devex: Devex will draft copy, can we get a tiny content review cycle (2 reviewers) in the design sprint next week?
Maria: also add a hidden flag to revert commits within 1 minute (soft undo) for pilot. pragmatic rollback for human mistakes.
Olivia: for audit display, can we have a compact diff we can expand? UI idea: small summary row that expands into a side panel with the full JSON diff and affected routes.
Jamie: yep. final blocker: RBAC — need to decide which roles can use ent-wizard. proposal: org-admins + delegated "tenant-admin" role. not tenant-operators.
Kevin: enforceable server-side. add permission check `entitlements:create:compact` and `entitlements:commit`.
Devex: small ask — SDK should provide a convenience helper that builds the compact payload from the console form. lowers integration bugs.
Maria: timeline: spike this week, design + proto next week, API PR then feature flag in 2 sprints. can anyone champion the spike?
Kevin: I'll take the spike and wire up the compact POST in a branch.
Jamie: thanks. I'll file a short RFC and tag design + security for review.
Olivia: happy to help with the cost delta UI mocks.
Devex: I'll schedule the content review.
Jamie: awesome — moving to action items: Kevin spike, Maria audit spec, Olivia UI mocks, Devex copy. ping here when spikes land. :thumbsup:
